newsitem.title: GREECE: Small-cap Pairis goes public Dec 4-6.
newsitem.headline: Small-cap Pairis goes public Dec 4-6.

text.p: Subscriptions to the initial public offering of plastics manufacturer Pairis will take place during December 4-6 for a listing on the Athens bourse's parallel market, the company said in a statement.
The company will issue 410,610 common registered shares at 1,150 drachmas a share. The shares will have a par value of 150 drachmas. Company advisor is Ergo Finance.
Pairis is tapping the market for 471.6 million drachmas. Issue advisor is Alpha Finance.
Lead underwriter for the issue is Ergo Bank joined by co-underwiters Alpha Credit Bank, Xiosbank, Alpha Brokerage, N. Devletoglou Securities and Omega Securities.
